svg.title: Level 2 filtered retrieval in practice
svg.desc: Registry records are filtered by profile and permission policy before search or model ranking. A denied deployment runner never enters the candidate set. A thin prompt-visible retrieval interface searches the eligible off-prompt catalog, ranks a small candidate set, inspects the deployment review skill, and activates its exact version for the request.
